Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2003
ORDINANCE IV OF
2003
BALOCHISTAN
GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Government Educational and Training
Institutions Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary 18th November, 2003]
No. Legis: 1-79/Law/84 dated
19-11-2003.---The following Ordinance made by the Government of Balochistan
on 13th November, 2003, is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan
Government Educational and Training Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment, of section 4 of Act XI of 1960

ORDINANCE IV OF 2003
ORDINANCE IV OF
2003
BALOCHISTAN
GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Government Educational and Training
Institutions Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary 18th November, 2003]
No. Legis: 1-79/Law/84 dated
19-11-2003.---The following Ordinance made by the Government of Balochistan
on 13th November, 2003, is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment, of section 4 of
Act XI of 1960.---(1) In the Balochistan Government. Educational and
Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960 for sub section (2) of section 4, the
following shall be substituted.
"(2) The Governor of
Balochistan or one of the Board members to be nominated by him shall be the Chairman
of the Board."
